page.content:
The Street Fighter II tournament cast and its later heirs.

How World Warriors connects

  • Character: Ryu — Ryu is the wandering center of the World Warriors.
  • Work: Street Fighter II — Street Fighter II introduced the World Warriors as a playable cast.
  • Character: Ken Masters — Ken Masters is Ryu's fellow World Warrior and rival.
  • Character: Chun-Li — Chun-Li is the Interpol World Warrior hunting Shadaloo.
  • Topic: Street Fighter — The World Warriors are Street Fighter's first family of fighters.
  • Character: Guile — Guile is the military World Warrior chasing M. Bison.
  • Event: World Warrior tournament — The World Warrior tournament gathers the World Warriors.
  • Character: Sagat — Sagat joined the World Warriors after Ryu scarred him.
  • Character: Zangief — Zangief is the wrestling World Warrior from Russia.
  • Character: Dhalsim — Dhalsim is the yoga World Warrior from India.
  • Character: Blanka — Blanka is the jungle World Warrior from Brazil.
  • Character: Luke Sullivan — Luke Sullivan is a later-generation World Warrior.
  • Character: Jamie Siu — Jamie Siu is a Metro City World Warrior in Street Fighter 6.

What is World Warriors?

The World Warriors are the multinational fighters gathered for the Street Fighter II tournament — Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, Guile, and the rest — a roster later games still treat as the series' first family.

Key threads lead to Ryu, Street Fighter II, Ken Masters, Chun-Li, Street Fighter and Guile.
